title: Menu trends
summary: Which items sold more or less than in the days just before, and menu items that didn't sell at all.

items: **Rising** and **Falling**: the biggest changes in units against the same number of days just before. Only items that sold at least 3 then are compared, so 1 to 3 isn't "up 200%".
**Not sold**: kitchen items still on the menu that didn't sell at all in the period.
Filter to **Kitchen** (prepared-food menus) or **Grocery** (the other menus).

blocks.text: The top and bottom sellers by sales are under [Best & worst sellers](article:insights-also-in-pos).
